snippet.title: You Can't See Ghosts! Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
👻 *You Can't See Ghosts* ! is a spatial awareness and deductive reasoning puzzle game with a charming story where you play as an invisible ghost. Bump into walls, step on glass, and other clues to locate yourself and reach the exit. Perfect for both experienced players and newcomers alike.

👉 *WISHLIST*  (it helps *a lot* ) and play *Demo* for free now on:
Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3165640/You_Cant_See_Ghosts
Itch.io - https://simplypassiongames.itch.io/you-cant-see-ghosts
